post.meaning: Like a lovely flower, bright and also fragrant, fine words bear fruit in one who acts on them.
post.caption:
A line from the Buddha for a calmer mind 🪷

📖 Dhammapada, Verse 52

इसमें से कौन-सी बात आपके दिल को लगी? कमेंट में बताएँ। 👇

#buddha #buddhism #buddhaquotes #dhammapada #mindfulness

reel.meaning: Once your mind is out of the swamp of delusion, you stop being pulled about by everything you hear.
reel.caption:
Krishna's words from the Bhagavad Gita, for whatever today brings 🦚

📖 Bhagavad Gita, 2.52

रोज़ एक वाणी के लिए Follow करें। 🙏

#krishna #bhagavadgita #radhekrishna #gita #sanatandharma
